verdict.rationale: The skill ships its own dependency-free Python command-line tools: a logo reference library searchable from the command line, SVG audit, board and PNG rendering, favicon export, and a packaging script. These are first-party scripts that support agent workflows, but the evidence shows no unified, documented official CLI. The `/plugin` install commands belong to the host platform, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: a single named official CLI binary, a command and flag reference, documented invocation syntax for each tool, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
